generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Category-IIA Category Contractors should upload a scanned copy of valid Caste Certificate and Domicile Certificate Issued from competent Authority and should submit the hard copy of original Category-IIA Caste certificate for verification, at the time opening of cover 1, If the bidder has firm then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to the Category-IIA Category
A copy of the valid registration certificate of KPWD Class-III contractor
Valid Registration of labour license certificate Form-C
Copy of Valid ESI Registration Certificate

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period ie 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26 Satisfactorily completed (at least 90 percent of the contract value) as prime contractor at least one any construction work costing work to an extent of 25% of value not less than Rs. 7.53 Lakhs (Usually not less than 50 percent estimated Value of Contract) (Updated to the FY in which the tender are invited. The value of the completed works shall be given weightage of 10 percent per year to bring them to the price level of FY in which the tenders are invited and the necessary work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer Equivalent officer of the concerned division

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period ie 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26 Achieved in at least ONE financial years an average annual financial turnover (in all Class of Civil Engineering Construction Works only) of Rs 30.11 Lakhs. (Usually not less than the estimated annual payment under this contract) (Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10 percent year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited). The Turnover certificate issued by registered chartered Accountants along with UDIN

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as Assessed available tender capacity is A x N x5-B where A is Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years at 2026-27 price level updated to the financial year N is equal to 1 year. B Value, at 2026-27 price level (updated to the financial year in which the tender is invited) of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1 year (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited

itemList.description: Providing Manpower to Water Management (Unskilled heavy Mazdoor) Maintenance of canal system, intakes for supply of water to field for irrigation / MI and ZP tank filling purpose duly maintaining operation of sluice gates/head regulator/escape regulators/cross regulators, removal jungle all types on SR & IP slope of the canal removal of silt and Obstruction during flow of water in canal, filling up / Maintaning SR & IP including raincuts of canal embankement / Cutting complete as per direction of Engineer Incharge
